verdict.rationale: Anytype gives users strong control over where their data is retained. Content is stored locally on-device, local-only mode disables the backup node entirely, self-hosting is supported, and data can be exported at any time. However, nothing in the evidence documents deletion controls such as deleting objects, spaces, or the account, purging server or backup copies, or setting retention policies. missing for 10: documented deletion/purge of objects, spaces, and accounts; removal of data from Anytype's backup nodes; retention-period settings; independent corroboration.
